subject: Midnight push: pilot uplift offer to secure Q3 commitment
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@quickpay.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2027 23:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot uplift offer — quick weekend support to lock Q3

Samira,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate how quickly the QuickPay team moved through the POC. We heard loud and clear that showing a little more runway and scale on ingestion will make a big difference for the internal review team.

Quick, pragmatic offer from our side to help close this quarter: we can top up your pilot with an additional 75K token-credit (apply to generation + embeddings) and extend the trial window by 7 days (new expiry Oct 7), conditional on a signed commitment to move to a paid Starter contract by Oct 14.

High-level terms: 
- 75,000 token credit applied to pilot usage (one-time)
- Trial extension: Oct 7
- Activation: we issue credit immediately on signature of the attached M A P and an emailed reply from QuickPay confirming the timeline

I've attached a brief mutual action plan and a redline-friendly proposal (one page). If this works, I can loop in Legal and run the simple DocuSign route tonight so your folks can review tomorrow morning.

Attachment: [mutual_action_plan_qp.pdf (application/pdf)]
Attachment: [proposal_terms_qp_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thoughts? If you want to talk through sizing or adjust the credit amount, happy to hop on a quick call.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192

From: Samira Khan <samira@quickpay.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2027 00:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot uplift offer — quick weekend support to lock Q3

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the fast follow. A few quick questions from our side before we escalate internally:

1) Is the 75K token credit refundable or applied only to pilot usage?
2) Any product constraints we should communicate to our infra team (KV cache behavior / cold-start expectations) if we ramp ingestion?
3) On the legal side, can QuickPay sign a one-page M A P + short exhibit instead of the full contract before Oct 14, and then finalize terms afterwards?

If you can confirm 1–3 we can present this to our head of Product and Legal first thing tomorrow. We might loop Legal in — I cc'd legal@quickpay.ai for visibility.

Short phone? I can do 08:30 PT.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, QuickPay
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2027 01:18:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot uplift offer — quick weekend support to lock Q3

Mateo —

Looked through the ask and QuickPay traction. Approve the uplift with conditions below:

- Approve 75K token credit to be applied immediately to pilot usage.
- Approve 7-day extension (new expiry Oct 7).
- Condition: QuickPay signs the attached one-page MAP acknowledging target MRR and a commitment to execute Starter contract by Oct 14. MAP must include product milestones we discussed (ingestion thresholds, acceptance test).
- If QuickPay moves to a Starter contract with >$5k/month ARR in first three months, Redwood will provide a second one-time operational credit of 25K tokens (subject to review).

Operational notes for Mateo / Solutions: please confirm no infra gating on our side; ask Infra/Runtime team to raise burst capacity limit for this tenant during the trial window and flag any sequence-length skews.

Approved by: Ben Carter (Sales Director)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@quickpay.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, QuickPay Legal <legal@quickpay.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot uplift offer — quick weekend support to lock Q3

Samira — great, thanks for the quick reply and for looping Legal. Answers inline below and next steps: 

1) Credit application: the 75K token credit is non-refundable and applied only to pilot usage during the trial window (we'll consume tokens first against the credit; any usage after that reverts to standard billing).

2) Infra notes: no feature gating required. We'll raise the tenant burst limits for the trial window and enable prefix KV warming to reduce cold-starts. Solutions will monitor latency and alert your infra lead if we see any degradation. I'll send a short runbook to your infra lead separately.

3) Legal: yes — QuickPay can sign the one-page M A P + exhibit as an initial commitment. The exhibit will list acceptance criteria and the Oct 14 signature target for the full Starter agreement. That is acceptable to us.

Next steps:
- I will upload the MAP and the short exhibit to DocuSign and send to legal@quickpay.ai now: https://www.docusign.com/sign/QP-2027-113-topup
- On signature we will apply the 75K token credit and extend the trial to Oct 7.
- Ben has approved a conditional second credit (25K) if Starter >$5k/mo ARR is met within the first 90 days — we'll track this in the deal notes: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/QP-2027-113

Attachment: [mutual_action_plan_qp.pdf] — same doc as before.

If you're good, sign the DocuSign and I'll confirm when the credit posts. If you prefer the MAP as inline edits, let me know and I'll make the quick change.

Talk soon — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
